BiblicalUsage: Zillah is one of the two wives of Lamech, the mother of Tubal-cain. In Genesis 4:19, the name of the other Zillah. The fuller story is told on the Zillah profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Zillah matters because God works through ordinary people, and no name in His book is there by accident.
